full_prompt_en: A square decorative anime illustration shows a long pink-haired figure in a formal uniform framed by abundant roses. The background is a large dark teal rounded panel centered on warm cream paper, with generous pale margins along both sides and the bottom. The figure stands full length at the center, upright with one arm lowered and the other partly lost beneath the sweeping hair. Long rose-pink hair flows widely to both sides in soft curling ribbons, crossing the shoulders and extending almost to the panel edges. A tailored black jacket has gold piping and epaulettes above a white ruffled neckpiece. A close black waist section and narrow pale belt divide the dark upper half from fitted white trousers and tall pale boots. The pose is calm and dignified; the face is small but visible beneath the bright hair, turned slightly toward the left. Clusters of pink roses and deep green leaves rise behind the body and gather densely around the lower legs, creating a floral oval within the dark panel. Small loose petals and pale flecks float in the remaining dark space. A slim red sword or scabbard appears near the right side, angling toward the lower edge. The rendering uses clean anime contours, smooth flat color regions, and delicate internal shadows; the flowers add textured, layered detail without obscuring the central silhouette. Soft frontal light brightens the white clothing and pink hair, while the teal ground stays even and dark, giving the warm floral colors a clear contrast. The overall composition is elegant and emblematic, balancing a tall central figure with symmetrical flower masses and broad cream negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性动漫插画呈现一位长粉发人物，身穿正式制服，被繁盛玫瑰围住。背景是一块居中的深青绿圆角大面板，置于暖奶油色纸面上，两侧和底部都有宽裕浅色边缘。人物全身立在中央，身体挺直，一只手臂下垂，另一只手部分藏在横扫的长发下。玫瑰粉长发向两侧宽阔流动，卷成柔软丝带，经过肩头，几乎伸到面板边缘。剪裁合身的黑外套有金色滚边和肩章，领前是白色褶饰。贴身黑腰段和窄浅色腰带把深上身与合体白长裤、高浅色靴子分开。姿态平静而庄重；脸在亮发下显得小巧，略转向左侧。粉色玫瑰与深绿叶簇在身体后升起，并在小腿周围密集聚集，在深色面板内形成花卉椭圆。细小散落花瓣和浅色碎点飘在剩余深色空间。右侧附近出现一柄细红色剑或剑鞘，斜向下缘。渲染使用干净动漫轮廓、平顺平涂色区和精细内部阴影；花朵增加有肌理的层叠细节，却不遮住中央剪影。柔和正面光提亮白衣与粉发，青绿底保持均匀深色，让暖色花朵得到清楚对比。整体构图优雅而具有徽章感，以高挑中央人物、近对称花团和宽阔奶油色留白取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The decorative anime image combines clean elongated silhouettes with smooth flat color, flowing curves, and densely clustered floral texture. A dark, simply shaped central field sits inside broad warm off-white negative space, turning the figure and ornament into a self-contained emblem. Soft pink and cream are concentrated against deep teal and black, with small gold and green accents giving the palette hierarchy. Contours remain crisp around the main form, while overlapping petals and leaves produce more intricate, softer internal edges. Light is gentle and frontal, keeping pale regions luminous without strong cast shadows. Vertical balance is reinforced by a tall central mass, sideward hairlike ribbons, and a rounded wreath of repeated small shapes. The overall effect is poised and romantic, with graphic clarity supported by controlled ornamental abundance.
style_prompt_zh: 这种装饰性动漫画面把干净修长的剪影与平顺平涂色、流动曲线和密集成簇的花形肌理结合。深色简形中央区域置于宽阔暖灰白留白内，让焦点与装饰成为自足徽章。柔粉和奶油色集中对照深青绿与黑色，少量金色和绿色重音建立色板层级。主要形体周围轮廓清脆，重叠花瓣与叶片则产生更繁复、更柔软的内部边缘。光柔和且偏正面，使浅色区域明亮，却没有强投影。高挑中央体块、向两侧流动的丝带状曲线及小形状反复围成的圆环加强竖向平衡。整体效果沉稳而浪漫，由受控的装饰丰盛支撑图形清晰度。
theme_en: A long pink-haired figure in a formal uniform framed by roses
theme_zh: 长粉发人物身穿正式制服，被玫瑰环绕
name: Revolutionary Girl Utena
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
